components.heading: Weighing or vending machines in public places.
components.text: It shall be unlawful for any person to place, install or maintain or cause to be placed, installed or maintained any automatic weighing or vending machine upon any street, avenue, sidewalk or other public place within the City. (Code 1981 § 40-23. Code 1995 § 130-39.)
